mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, we are seeing fair conditions near Badger Ridge Middle School. If you look to the Northwest near Verona High School at 5:01 PM, you might catch the International Space Station passing by as it travels toward the Northeast near Home Depot.

The City of Verona is reminding residents that city buildings will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving, with trash pickup delayed until Friday. Also, the Public Works department is evaluating their facility space to keep up with our growing community.
There are no public events listed in the city for the next 30 days, so it is a great time to enjoy the local parks and trails.
In a noteworthy call from November 3, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Prairie Way Boulevard which led to an arrest for intimidation and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor of the day at Culver's is OREO Cookie Overload. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by anytime before they close at 10:00 PM.
